name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand holding dumbbells beside the thighs with elbows slightly bent.
Raise the arms out and a little forward to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly along the same path.
cues: Keep hands and elbows at a similar height.
mistakes: Shrugging or turning thumbs sharply downward.
breathing: Exhale as you raise; inhale as you lower.
